what: Settings log of the dynamic comparison (VALIDATION_PLAN.md, amendment 4). A change is allowed only to reach convergence, judged by convergence and kinematic tracking error alone, never by force data; it applies to both arms.

versions.reason: initial settings, before any solve (Moco's tracking-example defaults: DeGrooteFregly muscles, rigid tendons, 6 Hz filter; mesh 0.04 s; tolerances 1e-2/1e-3)
versions.judged_by: pilot, subject2 squats1, 2026-11-06/07: arm A did not converge (3000 iterations, Maximum_Iterations_Exceeded; infeasibility never below ~2.6e2); arm B converged (1168 iterations) but did not track: pelvis translation RMS 672.5 mm, worst rotation RMS 50.5 deg (pelvis_tilt). Run stopped by the gate before the batch.

changes: new coordinate_weights: pelvis_tx, pelvis_ty, pelvis_tz x100 (value and speed); every other tracked coordinate stays at 1
versions.reason: v1 failed the pilot on convergence (arm A) and on tracking (arm B). Diagnosis from the solutions and the models alone, no force-plate data: arm B's 'converged' solution leaves the floor. It starts with the feet ~0.49 m below it, moving up fast enough that the smooth contact gives no force, and flies (lowest sphere up to 1.6 m above the floor) while the joint angles track. Its cost is mostly pelvis_ty speed tracking (110 of 138); muscles are almost idle (3.6). With unit weights in metres, leaving the floor is cheaper than squatting. Arm A ends with the feet ~0.5 m below the floor and contact forces up to ~7e7 N, held by mtp/ankle reserves up to 773 Nm. (1) Pelvis translations x100: a 0.67 m pelvis error then costs far more than any muscle effort, while the ~10 mm offset the contact needs to carry body weight costs ~0.1. (2) Mesh 0.04 -> 0.02 s: the contact's vertical natural period at standing, from each model in the reference posture, is ~170 ms (arm B) and ~95 ms (arm A, stiffer beyond ~10 mm); 0.04 s gave about 2.4 intervals per period for arm A, too few to resolve it.

pilot_gate.rule: the batch starts only if, with the current settings, both arms of the pilot converged and each solution's tracking RMS is within: every rotational coordinate <= 5 deg, each pelvis translation <= 20 mm (foot_models/dynamic_summary.py PILOT_GATE). Added with v2, because v1's gate (convergence only) would have accepted arm B's flying solution. A check of the settings, not part of validity.
